create_consistency_decoder_scheduler: create a ConsistencyDecoderScheduler with custom num_train_timesteps and sigma_data parameters
generate_betas_for_alpha_bar: generate a beta schedule tensor using cosine, exp, or laplace alpha transform types
set_timesteps_consistency_decoder: set the two-step inference timesteps for the consistency decoder scheduler on a device
scale_model_input_consistency_decoder: scale the denoising model input tensor by the current timestep c_in coefficient
step_consistency_decoder: predict the previous timestep sample by reversing the SDE using model output and noise
